english.title: Landlord use rent book with inadequate information
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the landlord of a dwelling at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..) where the rent book or similar document that was used did not contain both, a summary of the provisions of Part X of the Housing Act 1985 as prescribed and a statement of the permitted number of persons in relation to the dwelling
english.legislation: Contrary to section 332(2) of the Housing Act 1985.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

of a dwelling
a rent book or similar document did not contain a summary and statement of the provisions of Part X of the Housing Act 1985
